description:
Targets are edited through a small inline form behind the 14px "targets · today" text button (FuelPanel.tsx:96-98, 103-130), and only for protein and calories. PUT /api/fuel/target appends a row (fuel.ts, "Append-only"), so every past target is already on record, but nothing ever shows it.

- A Targets section on the Fuel Week view: four tiles. Carbs and fat can be set to "No target", which sends null (T-052). The edit control is a 44px target, not the 14px text button.
- GET /api/fuel/targets returns the append-only rows collapsed into ranges ("Sep 3 → now · 2,850 kcal · 185 g"). The page lists them under the tiles and says each past day is scored against the target it had, which is already true of GET /history.
- Saving still invalidates ["fuel","today"] and ["fuel","history"] (CLAUDE.md "Fuel target invalidation").

Mockup (deleted; this text is the spec) (Week, Targets).
title: Edit all four targets, with "no target" for carbs and fat, and show target history
